heading: EXT. HARBOR PARKING LOT - FOOD TRUCK "THE GOLDEN GOBLIN" - DAY

units.text: EXT. HARBOR PARKING LOT - FOOD TRUCK "THE GOLDEN GOBLIN" - DAY
A rusty purple truck with a huge cartoon goblin painted on the side.
Its painted eyes blink when nobody's looking.
A line of hungry customers stretches around the block.
Inside the truck, a tiny kitchen.
Steam, sizzle, clatter.
BIG DAVE, 50s, an enormous man with an apron that reads "Kiss the Cook (Please)," flips a patty.
Beside him, MO, 20s, wiry, chops onions with a nervous speed.
At the window, JEN, 30s, sharp ponytail, takes orders with a grin that could cut glass.
Perched on the shelf above the fryer sits SAM, a one-foot-tall goblin in a chef's hat, grumpy, covered in flour.
Only the crew can see him.
Next! What'll it be?
units.name: JEN

units.text: Orders up, people! Let's move!
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Don't cut your finger. Don't cut your finger.
units.name: MO

units.text: Mo, you've said that eleven times. I'm counting.
units.name: SAM

units.text: You're not helping, Sam.
units.name: MO

units.text: Two Goblin Specials and a side of fries!
units.name: JEN

units.text: Fries are in the basket, Mo!
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: I know. I know where the fries are.
units.name: MO

units.text: Jen's phone RINGS on the counter.
She answers on speaker.
Jennifer? It is Mrs. K. I am watching the line on the news. It is too long.
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: Mrs. K, we're doing great. Lots of customers.
units.name: JEN

units.text: Too many customers is no profit if you give them free pickles.
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: Who told her about the pickles?
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: She has her ways.
units.name: SAM

units.text: I hear everything. Mo is cutting too slow.
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: I'm not cutting too slow!
units.name: MO

units.text: Mo, speak to me when your onions are finished.
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: Mo glances at Big Dave.
Big Dave shakes his head slowly.
Okay, everyone calm down.
units.name: JEN

units.text: NOBODY CALMS DOWN.
The fryer HISSES.
Smoke curls toward the ceiling.
Dave, the oil's too hot.
units.name: SAM

units.text: It's fine.
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Dave.
units.name: SAM

units.text: It's fine!
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: The fryer POPS.
A tiny fireball rolls up the wall.
FIRE!
units.name: MO

units.text: Mrs. K, I'll call you back!
units.name: JEN

units.text: Jennifer, do not hang up on--
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: Jen hangs up.
Big Dave grabs a fire extinguisher.
SPLOOSH.
A cloud of white foam engulfs the kitchen.
Silence.
Everyone is covered in foam.
Sam wipes his face with one tiny hand.
I told you.
units.name: SAM

units.text: From outside, the line of customers CHEERS.
